newsitem.title: USA: Boy held in Arkansas mother-baby murders.
newsitem.headline: Boy held in Arkansas mother-baby murders.

text.p: Police in Helena, Ark., said on Friday they were holding a 15-year-old boy for the murders of his teenage sister and her baby in a dispute over which of them would wash the dishes.
"He told us that's why they argued," Sgt. Mark McCarty of the Helena police said.

Officials said the teenager, whose name was not released because of his age, was arrested on Thursday night after the shooting death of his 18-year-old sister and the beating death of her five-month-old son.

Police said the infant died of a broken neck and a fractured skull, and was found on the sidewalk outside the home. They said the infant's mother was struck by at least four and possibly six bullets, most of them fired into her head at close range.
The suspect's 35-year-old mother was also wounded in the attack. Police said she was hit by gunfire as she ran from the home carrying another of her daughter's children.
